'''Andan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] operative of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] who was sent by [[Darth Malgus]] as part of a strike team to capture the ''[[Allusis]]''.
